title.narrative: To reduce HIV infections by 75%, new HIV infections among children by less than 5%, AIDS related deaths by 70% and Stigma and Discrimination to 13.8%, all by 2023. - Tanzania (United Republic) (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Tanzania (United Republic), HIV, Ministry of Finance of the United Republic of Tanzania (MoF)This program has the following goals: To reduce new HIV infections by 75% in 2020, and by 85% in 2023. To reduce new HIV infections among children to less than 5% by 2023. To reduce AIDS related deaths by 50% in 2020 and 70% by the end of 2023. To reduce stigma and discrimination to 13.83% by 2023 from 25.60 in 2017. The objectives of this program are: To implement efficient testing strategies so that 95% of people living with HIV will know their status by 2022. To implement client centered ART care so that 95% of all people diagnosed with HIV are enrolled, followed up and receive timely and efficacious HAART by 2022. To optimize ART so that 95% of all people receiving ART will attain sustainable viral suppression by 2022. To increase percentage of women and men engaged in non-marital, non-cohabiting partner reporting use of a condom at last sexual intercourse to 50% by 2023 from 31.7% in 2017. To reduce the incidence of STIs in the general population and in pregnant women by 50% by 2023. To reduce the percentage of mother to child transmission at the end of breast feeding period, from an estimated 8% (in 2015), to 4% by the end of 2023. To reduce the burden of other HIV co-infections and co-morbidities amongst PLHIV by 50 percent of the 2016 level by 2022

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for TZA-H-MOFP03
Number of new HIV infections per 1000 uninfected population
Estimated percentage of children newly infected with HIV from mother-to-child transmission among women living with HIV delivering in the past 12 months
Number of AIDS-related deaths per 100,000 population
Percentage of HIV positive adults aged 15 years and above who reported stigma / discriminatory attitude in health facilities and other essential service centres in the past 12 months
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for TZA-H-MOFP03
Percentage of HIV-positive results among the total HIV tests performed during the reporting period
Proportion of HIV positive women on HIV care screened for cervical cancer
Percentage of HIV-positive women who received ART during pregnancy and/or labour and delivery
Percentage of facilities which record and submit data using the electronic information system
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Percentage of antenatal care attendees tested for syphilis
Percentage of PLHIV on ART who initiated TB preventive therapy among those eligible during the reporting period
Timeliness of facility reporting: Percentage of submitted facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Percentage of people on ART among all people living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of health facilities with tracer medicines for the three diseases available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
Outcome indicators targets and results for TZA-H-MOFP03
Percentage of women aged 15-19 who have had a live birth or are currently pregnant
Percent of respondents who say they used a condom the last time they had sex with a non-marital, non-cohabiting partner, of those who have had sex with such a partner in the last 12 months
Percentage of ever-married or partnered women aged 15-49 who experienced physical or sexual violence from a male intimate partner in the past 12 months
Percentage of people living with HIV who know their HIV status at the end of the reporting period

Percentage of people living with HIV not on ART at the end of the reporting period among people living with HIV who were either on ART at the end of the last reporting period or newly initiated on ART during the reporting period
Percentage of sex workers reporting using a condom with their most recent client
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART who are virologically suppressed
